quote: Xiong et al. (2023) observed that the replacement of fresh fish with formulated feed significantly increased aldehyde concentrations in the muscle tissue of Chinese mitten crabs
statement: 用配合饲料替代鲜鱼显著增加了中华绒螯蟹肌肉组织中的醛类浓度。
text_zh: 用配合饲料替代鲜鱼显著增加了中华绒螯蟹肌肉组织中的醛类浓度。
text_en: Replacing fresh fish with formulated feed significantly increased the concentration of aldehydes in the muscle tissue of Chinese mitten crabs.
intervention: Replacing fresh fish with formulated feed

quote: Tan et al. reported a 2.25-fold increase in furan, 2-pentyl- content in the meat of pen-fed yaks compared to pasture-raised yaks
statement: 与放牧饲养的牦牛相比，圈养牦牛肉中2-戊基呋喃含量增加了2.25倍。
text_zh: 与放牧饲养的牦牛相比，圈养牦牛肉中2-戊基呋喃含量增加了2.25倍。
text_en: Compared to grazing yaks, the content of 2-pentylfuran in meat from confined yaks increased by 2.25 times.

quote: A formulated diet improved digestive capacity, immune function and intestinal microbiota structure of juvenile hybrid grouper (Epinephelus fuscoguttatus ♀ × Epinephelus lanceolatus ♂) when compared
statement: 与某种饲料相比，配合饲料改善了杂交石斑鱼幼鱼的消化能力、免疫功能和肠道微生物群结构。
text_zh: 与某种饲料相比，配合饲料改善了杂交石斑鱼幼鱼的消化能力、免疫功能和肠道微生物群结构。
text_en: Compared to a certain feed, compound feed improved the digestive capacity, immune function, and gut microbiota structure of juvenile hybrid grouper.

population.species: 杂交石斑鱼 (Epinephelus fuscoguttatus ♀ × Epinephelus lanceolatus ♂)

outcome: 消化能力、免疫功能及肠道微生物群结构

quote: It suggested that si983 could apparently down-modulate the propagation of SCRV and postpone the emergence of CPE.
statement: 这表明si983可以显著下调SCRV的传播并推迟细胞病变效应的出现。
text_zh: 这表明si983可以显著下调SCRV的传播并推迟细胞病变效应的出现。
text_en: This indicates that si983 can significantly downregulate SCRV transmission and delay the appearance of cytopathic effects.

quote:
Fish oil is
particularly popular in aquafeed industry because of its
high proportions of n-3 long-chain polyunsaturated fatty
acids (LC-PUFA) that play an important role in suppor-
ting normal growth, health, and nutritional quality of
farmed aquatic animals (Turchini et al. 2011b).
statement: 鱼油因其高比例的n-3长链多不饱和脂肪酸而在养殖饲料工业中特别受欢迎，这些脂肪酸在支持养殖水生动物的正常生长、健康和营养质量方面起着重要作用。
text_zh: 鱼油因其高比例的n-3长链多不饱和脂肪酸而在养殖饲料工业中特别受欢迎，这些脂肪酸在支持养殖水生动物的正常生长、健康和营养质量方面起着重要作用。
text_en: Fish oil is particularly popular in the aquaculture feed industry due to its high proportion of n-3 long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acids, which play an important role in supporting the normal growth, health, and nutritional quality of farmed aquatic animals.

quote: Among the siRNAs we examined, si983 was most effective at reducing virus titer compared to the mock group.
statement: 在检测的siRNAs中，与对照组相比，si983在降低病毒滴度方面最有效。
text_zh: 在检测的siRNAs中，与对照组相比，si983在降低病毒滴度方面最有效。
text_en: Among the siRNAs tested, si983 was the most effective in reducing viral titer compared to the control group.
outcome: 病毒载量/疾病严重程度

quote: Furthermore, RNAi targeting of the N gene may represent a viable method of treating against SCRV infection.
statement: 此外，靶向N基因的RNA干扰可能代表一种治疗SCRV感染的可行方法。
text_zh: 此外，靶向N基因的RNA干扰可能代表一种治疗SCRV感染的可行方法。
text_en: In addition, RNA interference targeting the N gene may represent a feasible method for treating SCRV infection.

quote: Currently, the effective prevention of rhabdovirus infection in aquaculture remains to be developed.
statement: 目前，水产养殖中弹状病毒感染的有效预防方法尚未开发出来。
text_zh: 目前，水产养殖中弹状病毒感染的有效预防方法尚未开发出来。
text_en: Currently, effective prevention methods for rhabdovirus infection in aquaculture have not been developed.

quote: A pilot study in our laboratory has shown that the size, shape, and texture of the feed pellets play an important role in the acceptance of artificial diets by mandarin fish which is well known for its very unique food preference (Liang et al. 1998; Li et al. 2017).
statement: 一项实验室初步研究表明，饲料颗粒的大小、形状和质地对鳜鱼接受人工饲料起着重要作用。
text_zh: 一项实验室初步研究表明，饲料颗粒的大小、形状和质地对鳜鱼接受人工饲料起着重要作用。
text_en: A preliminary laboratory study showed that the size, shape and texture of feed pellets play an important role in the acceptance of artificial feed by mandarin fish.

quote:
The fish was found to be
most attracted to the 15 to 18-mm-long moist pellets,
which contained more than 30% moisture.
statement: 研究发现，鱼最被吸引的是长度在15到18毫米之间、含水量超过30%的湿润颗粒。
text_zh: 研究发现，鱼最被吸引的是长度在15到18毫米之间、含水量超过30%的湿润颗粒。
text_en: The study found that fish were most attracted to moist particles with a length of 15 to 18 mm and a moisture content exceeding 30%.

quote: its commercial production still relies on expensive live prey
statement: 鳜鱼（Siniperca scherzeri）的商业化养殖目前仍依赖于昂贵的活饵。
text_zh: 鳜鱼（Siniperca scherzeri）的商业化养殖目前仍依赖于昂贵的活饵。
text_en: The commercial farming of Siniperca scherzeri currently still relies on expensive live bait.

quote: A recent feeding trial with mandarin fish juveniles, of < 9 g, in our laboratory demonstrated that a diet containing 55% crude protein and 14% crude lipid yielded the best feeding and growth performance (Sankian et al. 2017).
statement: 一项针对体重小于9克的鳜鱼幼鱼的近期饲养试验表明，含有55%粗蛋白和14%粗脂质的饲料产生了最佳的摄食和生长性能。
text_zh: 一项针对体重小于9克的鳜鱼幼鱼的近期饲养试验表明，含有55%粗蛋白和14%粗脂质的饲料产生了最佳的摄食和生长性能。
text_en: A recent feeding trial on juvenile mandarin fish weighing less than 9 g showed that a diet containing 55% crude protein and 14% crude lipid produced the best feed intake and growth performance.
intervention: Diet with 55% crude protein and 14% crude lipid

quote: Fish were deprived of feed for 16 h prior to weighing or sampling to minimize hand-ling stress on fish.
statement: 在称重或采样前禁食16小时以尽量减少对鱼的操作应激。
text_zh: 在称重或采样前禁食16小时以尽量减少对鱼的操作应激。
text_en: Fasting for 16 hours before weighing or sampling to minimize handling stress on fish.

quote: Blood samples were collected from the caudal veins of six anesthetized (200 mg/L MS-222, Sigma, St. Louis, MO, USA) individual fish per tank (nine fish/dietary treatment) using heparinized syringes.
statement: 使用肝素化注射器从每缸六条经麻醉（200 mg/L MS-222）的个体鱼的尾静脉采集血液样本。
text_zh: 使用肝素化注射器从每缸六条经麻醉（200 mg/L MS-222）的个体鱼的尾静脉采集血液样本。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the caudal vein of six anesthetized fish (200 mg/L MS-222) per tank using heparinized syringes.

quote: A 12-week feeding trial was designed to evaluate the effect of total replacement of fish oil (FO) with terrestrial alternative oils on growth, feed utilization, body composition, hematological parameters, and fillet fatty acid profile of mandarin fish juveniles.
statement: 一项为期12周的饲养试验旨在评估用陆地替代油完全替代鱼油对鳜鱼幼鱼生长、饲料利用、体成分、血液学参数和鱼肉脂肪酸谱的影响。
text_zh: 一项为期12周的饲养试验旨在评估用陆地替代油完全替代鱼油对鳜鱼幼鱼生长、饲料利用、体成分、血液学参数和鱼肉脂肪酸谱的影响。
text_en: A 12-week feeding trial aimed to evaluate the effects of complete replacement of fish oil with terrestrial alternative oils on the growth, feed utilization, body composition, hematological parameters, and muscle fatty acid profile of juvenile mandarin fish.
intervention: Complete fish oil replacement with terrestrial oils
intervention_record: 陆地油脂完全替代鱼油

quote: However, daily feed intake was found to be significantly higher for fish fed the SO diet compared with those fed the FO and LO diets.
statement: 然而，与饲喂鱼油和亚麻籽油日粮的鱼相比，饲喂大豆油日粮的鱼的每日摄食量显著更高。
text_zh: 然而，与饲喂鱼油和亚麻籽油日粮的鱼相比，饲喂大豆油日粮的鱼的每日摄食量显著更高。
text_en: However, the daily feed intake of fish fed a soybean oil diet was significantly higher than that of fish fed fish oil and linseed oil diets.

quote: Plasma samples were analyzed for TP, TCHO, AST, ALT, ALP, ALB, and TBIL concentrations using an automated blood analyzer (DRI-CHEM NX500i, FUJIFILM Corpo- ration Tokyo, Japan).
statement: 血浆样本使用自动血液分析仪分析了总蛋白、总胆固醇、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、丙氨酸氨基转移酶、碱性磷酸酶、白蛋白和总胆红素的浓度。
text_zh: 血浆样本使用自动血液分析仪分析了总蛋白、总胆固醇、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、丙氨酸氨基转移酶、碱性磷酸酶、白蛋白和总胆红素的浓度。
text_en: Plasma samples were analyzed for concentrations of total protein, total cholesterol, aspartate aminotransferase, alanine aminotransferase, alkaline phosphatase, albumin, and total bilirubin using an automatic blood analyzer.

quote:
The fish were acclimated to the experimental condition in a
5000-L glass tank, connected to a recirculation system, at
the GWNU Marine Biology Center in ambient freshwater
temperature (24 ± 0.1 °C, mean ± SE), feeding on a repelleted
commercial feed (50% crude protein and 13% lipid;
Woosung, Daejeon, South Korea) with the same size as
the experimental diets.
statement: 鱼在连接循环系统的5000升玻璃缸中适应实验条件，水温为24±0.1°C，投喂与实验饲料尺寸相同的挤压成型商业饲料（粗蛋白50%，脂质13%）。
text_zh: 鱼在连接循环系统的5000升玻璃缸中适应实验条件，水温为24±0.1°C，投喂与实验饲料尺寸相同的挤压成型商业饲料（粗蛋白50%，脂质13%）。
text_en: Fish were acclimated to experimental conditions in a 5000-liter glass tank connected to a recirculating system, with water temperature at 24±0.1°C, and fed extruded commercial feed of the same size as the experimental diet (50% crude protein, 13% lipid).

quote: It is also now generally recognized that partial or full substitution of FO is more feasible for freshwater fish than marine species which apparently lack the ability to desaturate and elongate C18 PUFA and therefore are very prone to n-3 LC-PUFA deficiency (Tocher 2010).
statement: 目前普遍认为，对于淡水鱼类而言，部分或完全替代鱼油比海洋鱼类更可行，因为海洋鱼类显然缺乏对C18多不饱和脂肪酸进行去饱和和延长的能力，因此极易出现n-3长链多不饱和脂肪酸缺乏症。
text_zh: 目前普遍认为，对于淡水鱼类而言，部分或完全替代鱼油比海洋鱼类更可行，因为海洋鱼类显然缺乏对C18多不饱和脂肪酸进行去饱和和延长的能力，因此极易出现n-3长链多不饱和脂肪酸缺乏症。
text_en: It is currently widely accepted that for freshwater fish, partial or complete replacement of fish oil is more feasible than for marine fish, because marine fish clearly lack the ability to desaturate and elongate C18 polyunsaturated fatty acids, and are therefore highly susceptible to n-3 long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acid deficiency.
limitations: 海洋鱼类因代谢能力限制易患缺乏症

quote: The replacement of the dietary FO by three different oils, in the present study, did not affect the morpho- logical indices of fish, which is often used to indicate the nutritional status of fish.
statement: 本研究中，用三种不同的油替代日粮中的鱼油未影响鱼的形态学指标。
text_zh: 本研究中，用三种不同的油替代日粮中的鱼油未影响鱼的形态学指标。
text_en: In this study, replacing fish oil in the diet with three different oils did not affect the morphological indicators of the fish.

quote: However, the DFI value in fish fed with SO diet was significantly higher than those of fish fed the FO and LO diets.
statement: 然而，饲喂大豆油（SO）日粮的鱼其每日摄食量（DFI）显著高于饲喂鱼油（FO）和亚麻籽油（LO）日粮的鱼。
text_zh: 然而，饲喂大豆油（SO）日粮的鱼其每日摄食量（DFI）显著高于饲喂鱼油（FO）和亚麻籽油（LO）日粮的鱼。
text_en: However, the daily feed intake (DFI) of fish fed soybean oil (SO) diets was significantly higher than that of fish fed fish oil (FO) and linseed oil (LO) diets.

statement: 鱼油组和亚麻籽油组的饲料效率（FE）高于豆油组和猪油组。
text_zh: 鱼油组和亚麻籽油组的饲料效率（FE）高于豆油组和猪油组。
text_en: Feed efficiency (FE) in the fish oil group and linseed oil group was higher than in the soybean oil group and lard group.

statement: 各组存活率均在97%以上，其中亚麻籽油组略低。
text_zh: 各组存活率均在97%以上，其中亚麻籽油组略低。
text_en: Survival rates in all groups were above 97%, with the flaxseed oil group being slightly lower.

quote:
The DFI of fish
fed the SO diet was significantly higher than those of fish
fed FO and LO diets.
statement: 喂食大豆油组的日摄食量显著高于喂食鱼油和亚麻籽油组的鱼。
text_zh: 喂食大豆油组的日摄食量显著高于喂食鱼油和亚麻籽油组的鱼。
text_en: The daily feed intake of fish in the soybean oil feeding group was significantly higher than that of fish in the fish oil and linseed oil feeding groups.

quote:
No remarkable differences on DPI,
FE, and PER were observed among any of the treatments
(P > 0.05).
statement: 各处理组之间的日蛋白质摄入量、饲料效率和蛋白质效率比没有显著差异。
text_zh: 各处理组之间的日蛋白质摄入量、饲料效率和蛋白质效率比没有显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in daily protein intake, feed efficiency, and protein efficiency ratio among the treatment groups.

quote:
The survival rate was higher than 97%, and there
was no significant difference among all experimental
groups.
statement: 存活率高于97%，且所有实验组之间无显著差异。
text_zh: 存活率高于97%，且所有实验组之间无显著差异。
text_en: Survival rate was higher than 97%, and there was no significant difference among all experimental groups.

quote:
Therefore, the decreased deposition of dietary
ALA, LA, and OA along with good growth, feed
utilization, and survival in this study is suggestive of the
ability of mandarin fish to meet their essential fatty acid
requirement by the use of C18 PUFA.
statement: 因此，本研究中膳食ALA、LA和OA沉积减少以及良好的生长、饲料利用率和存活率表明鳜鱼能够利用C18 PUFA满足其必需脂肪酸需求。
text_zh: 因此，本研究中膳食ALA、LA和OA沉积减少以及良好的生长、饲料利用率和存活率表明鳜鱼能够利用C18 PUFA满足其必需脂肪酸需求。
text_en: Therefore, the reduced deposition of dietary ALA, LA and OA, along with good growth, feed utilization and survival rates in this study indicate that Chinese perch can utilize C18 PUFA to meet their essential fatty acid requirements.
intervention: C18 PUFA replacing part of lipid sources

quote: Dietary 160 mg/Kg C-I20 supplementation dramatically reduce inflammation of various internal organs, and improve intestinal mucosal barrier, intestinal morphology, growth performance, fillets quality and fillets nutritive value.
statement: 日粮中添加160 mg/Kg的C-I20显著减少各种内部器官的炎症，并改善肠道黏膜屏障、肠道形态、生长性能、鱼片质量和鱼片营养价值。
text_zh: 日粮中添加160 mg/Kg的C-I20显著减少各种内部器官的炎症，并改善肠道黏膜屏障、肠道形态、生长性能、鱼片质量和鱼片营养价值。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with 160 mg/Kg of C-I20 significantly reduced inflammation in various internal organs and improved intestinal mucosal barrier, intestinal morphology, growth performance, fillet quality, and fillet nutritional value.
outcome: 炎症反应、肠道健康、生长性能及肉质品质

quote: In conclusion, dietary C-I20 in a reasonable concentration supplementation effectively alleviates the negative effects of SM by improving the intestinal mucosal barrier.
statement: 总之，合理浓度的日粮C-I20补充通过改善肠道黏膜屏障，有效缓解了豆粕的负面影响。
text_zh: 总之，合理浓度的日粮C-I20补充通过改善肠道黏膜屏障，有效缓解了豆粕的负面影响。
text_en: In summary, supplementation with a reasonable concentration of dietary C-I20 effectively alleviated the negative effects of soybean meal by improving the intestinal mucosal barrier.
outcome: 缓解饲料原料负面效应

quote: Nanopeptide C-I20 effectively reduces the negative effects of soybean meal.
statement: 纳米肽C-I20有效减少了豆粕的负面影响。
text_zh: 纳米肽C-I20有效减少了豆粕的负面影响。
text_en: Nano-peptide C-I20 effectively reduced the negative effects of soybean meal.

quote: C-I20 maintains suitable intestinal mucosal barrier and intestine morphology.
statement: C-I20维持了适宜的肠道黏膜屏障和肠道形态。
text_zh: C-I20维持了适宜的肠道黏膜屏障和肠道形态。
text_en: C-I20 maintained an appropriate intestinal mucosal barrier and intestinal morphology.
outcome: 肠道形态与屏障完整性

quote: C-I20 significantly reduces multi-type tissue injury.
statement: C-I20显著减少了多类型组织损伤。
text_zh: C-I20显著减少了多类型组织损伤。
text_en: C-I20 significantly reduced multi-type tissue damage.

quote: However, the fillet quality traits and development rate of breeding objects will be adversely impacted by the presence of anti-nutritional elements (such as saponins, antivitamin factor and phytic acid) and amino acid imbalance in plant protein
statement: 植物蛋白中的抗营养因子和氨基酸不平衡会对养殖对象的鱼片品质性状和发育速率产生不利影响。
text_zh: 植物蛋白中的抗营养因子和氨基酸不平衡会对养殖对象的鱼片品质性状和发育速率产生不利影响。
text_en: Anti-nutritional factors and amino acid imbalances in plant proteins have adverse effects on the fillet quality traits and growth rate of farmed aquatic animals.

quote: In this study, we prepared nano antibacterial peptide CMCS-gcIFN-20H (C-I20) with excellent sustained-release and anti-enzymolysis, and fed mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ) with a SM diet supplemented with different levels of C-I20 (320, 160, 80, 40, 0 mg/Kg) for 10 weeks.
statement: 本研究制备了具有优异缓释和抗酶解性能的纳米抗菌肽CMCS-gcIFN-20H（C-I20），并以不同水平（320、160、80、40、0 mg/Kg）的C-I20补充大豆粕日粮喂养鳜鱼10周。
text_zh: 本研究制备了具有优异缓释和抗酶解性能的纳米抗菌肽CMCS-gcIFN-20H（C-I20），并以不同水平（320、160、80、40、0 mg/Kg）的C-I20补充大豆粕日粮喂养鳜鱼10周。
text_en: This study prepared a nano-antimicrobial peptide CMCS-gcIFN-20H (C-I20) with excellent sustained-release and anti-enzymatic hydrolysis properties, and fed mandarin fish for 10 weeks on soybean meal-based diets supplemented with different levels of C-I20 (320, 160, 80, 40, 0 mg/Kg).

quote: 160 mg/Kg C-I20 treatment significantly improved the final body weight, weight gain rate and crude protein content of mandarin fish and reduced feed conversion ratio.
statement: 160 mg/Kg的C-I20处理显著提高了鳜鱼的终末体重、增重率和粗蛋白含量，并降低了饲料系数。
text_zh: 160 mg/Kg的C-I20处理显著提高了鳜鱼的终末体重、增重率和粗蛋白含量，并降低了饲料系数。
text_en: Treatment with 160 mg/Kg C-I20 significantly increased the final body weight, weight gain rate, and crude protein content of mandarin fish, and decreased the feed conversion ratio.

quote: 160 mg/Kg C-I20-fed fish maintained appropriate goblet cells number and mucin thickness, as well as improved villus length, intestinal cross-sectional area.
statement: 饲喂160 mg/Kg C-I20的鱼维持了适当的杯状细胞数量和黏液厚度，并改善了绒毛长度和肠道横截面积。
text_zh: 饲喂160 mg/Kg C-I20的鱼维持了适当的杯状细胞数量和黏液厚度，并改善了绒毛长度和肠道横截面积。
text_en: Fish fed 160 mg/Kg C-I20 maintained appropriate goblet cell numbers and mucus thickness, and improved villus length and intestinal cross-sectional area.

quote: Based on these advantageous physiological changes, 160 mg/Kg C-I20 treatment effectively reduced multi-type tissue (liver, trunk kidney, head kidney and spleen) injury.
statement: 基于这些有利的生理变化，160 mg/Kg的C-I20处理有效减少了多种组织（肝脏、躯干肾、头肾和脾脏）的损伤。
text_zh: 基于这些有利的生理变化，160 mg/Kg的C-I20处理有效减少了多种组织（肝脏、躯干肾、头肾和脾脏）的损伤。
text_en: Based on these favorable physiological changes, treatment with C-I20 at 160 mg/Kg effectively reduced damage in multiple tissues (liver, trunk kidney, head kidney and spleen).

quote: Before handling, fish were anesthetized using 3-Aminobenzoic acid ethyl ester methanesulfonate (140 mg/L, Solarbio, Beijing, China).
statement: 在处理前，鱼使用甲磺酸3-氨基苯甲酸乙酯（MS-222）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在处理前，鱼使用甲磺酸3-氨基苯甲酸乙酯（MS-222）进行麻醉。
text_en: Before processing, the fish were anesthetized with ethyl 3-aminobenzoate methanesulfonate (MS-222).
outcome: 操作应激与痛苦最小化

quote: All the efforts were made to minimize animal suffering.
statement: 所有努力都旨在最大限度地减少动物的痛苦。
text_zh: 所有努力都旨在最大限度地减少动物的痛苦。
text_en: All efforts are aimed at minimizing animal suffering.

quote: A previous study reported that soybean meal (SM) may lead to an imbalance in the oxidation/antioxidant system in farmed animals and enhanced hardness of farmed animal muscle
statement: 先前的研究报告称，豆粕可能导致养殖动物氧化/抗氧化系统失衡并增加肌肉硬度。
text_zh: 先前的研究报告称，豆粕可能导致养殖动物氧化/抗氧化系统失衡并增加肌肉硬度。
text_en: Previous research reports have stated that soybean meal may cause an imbalance in the oxidation/antioxidant system of farmed animals and increase muscle hardness.

quote: Cell apoptosis and elevated inflammation also enhanced the tissue damage and hardness of farmed animal muscle
statement: 细胞凋亡和炎症加剧也增强了养殖动物肌肉的组织损伤和硬度。
text_zh: 细胞凋亡和炎症加剧也增强了养殖动物肌肉的组织损伤和硬度。
text_en: Increased apoptosis and inflammation also enhanced tissue damage and hardness in the muscle of farmed animals.

quote: It has been demonstrated that several AMPs, such as antimicrobial peptides A3 and P5, colicin E1, cecropin AD and lactoferricin, have positive impacts on growth performance, intestinal morphology, antioxidant capacity and fecal microflora
statement: 已证明几种抗菌肽（如A3、P5、大肠杆菌素E1、天蚕素AD和乳铁蛋白）对生长性能、肠道形态、抗氧化能力和粪便微生物群有积极影响。
text_zh: 已证明几种抗菌肽（如A3、P5、大肠杆菌素E1、天蚕素AD和乳铁蛋白）对生长性能、肠道形态、抗氧化能力和粪便微生物群有积极影响。
text_en: Several antimicrobial peptides (such as A3, P5, colicin E1, cecropin AD, and lactoferrin) have been proven to have positive effects on growth performance, intestinal morphology, antioxidant capacity, and fecal microbiota.

quote: It has been reported that some antimicrobial peptides have significant effects on the regulation of the intestinal mucosal barrier ( 14 , 15 ).
statement: 据报道，一些抗菌肽对调节肠道黏膜屏障有显著影响。
text_zh: 据报道，一些抗菌肽对调节肠道黏膜屏障有显著影响。
text_en: It is reported that some antimicrobial peptides have a significant effect on regulating the intestinal mucosal barrier.

quote: In addition, antimicrobial peptides, an important active component of compound feed, play an important role in preventing inflammation ( 11 , 12 ).
statement: 此外，作为配合饲料重要活性成分的抗菌肽在预防炎症方面发挥重要作用。
text_zh: 此外，作为配合饲料重要活性成分的抗菌肽在预防炎症方面发挥重要作用。
text_en: In addition, antimicrobial peptides, as important active ingredients in compound feed, play an important role in preventing inflammation.

quote: Therefore, we speculate that antimicrobial peptides with the ability to inhibit inflammation and regulate the intestinal mucosal barrier can improve the growth performance and muscle quality of cultured fish.
statement: 因此，作者推测具有抑制炎症和调节肠道黏膜屏障能力的抗菌肽可以改善养殖鱼类的生长性能和肌肉品质。
text_zh: 因此，作者推测具有抑制炎症和调节肠道黏膜屏障能力的抗菌肽可以改善养殖鱼类的生长性能和肌肉品质。
text_en: Therefore, the authors speculate that antimicrobial peptides with the ability to inhibit inflammation and regulate the intestinal mucosal barrier can improve the growth performance and muscle quality of farmed fish.

quote: We conjugated gcIFN-20H and CMCS to develop a novel AMP reagent CMCS-gcIFN-20H (CMCS-20H), and found CMCS-20H can retard degradation, prevent bacterial infection, improve intestinal mucosal barrier and regulate intestinal flora ( 19 ).
statement: 作者将gcIFN-20H与CMCS结合开发了新型抗菌肽试剂CMCS-gcIFN-20H（CMCS-20H），发现CMCS-20H可以延缓降解、预防细菌感染、改善肠道黏膜屏障并调节肠道菌群。
text_zh: 作者将gcIFN-20H与CMCS结合开发了新型抗菌肽试剂CMCS-gcIFN-20H（CMCS-20H），发现CMCS-20H可以延缓降解、预防细菌感染、改善肠道黏膜屏障并调节肠道菌群。
text_en: The authors developed a novel antimicrobial peptide reagent, CMCS-gcIFN-20H (CMCS-20H), by combining gcIFN-20H with CMCS, and found that CMCS-20H can delay degradation, prevent bacterial infection, improve the intestinal mucosal barrier, and regulate the gut microbiota.
outcome: 肠道健康与抗感染能力

quote: Four fish in each tank (twelve fish in each group) anesthetized and dissected to obtain white muscle samples for analysis of flesh texture parameters (hardness, springiness, and chewiness).
statement: 对每个水箱中的四条鱼（每组十二条）进行麻醉和解剖，以获取白肉样本用于分析肉质质地参数。
text_zh: 对每个水箱中的四条鱼（每组十二条）进行麻醉和解剖，以获取白肉样本用于分析肉质质地参数。
text_en: Four fish per tank (twelve per group) were anesthetized and dissected to obtain white flesh samples for analysis of meat texture parameters.
outcome: 屠宰前处理与取样操作

quote: Dietary nanopeptide CMCS-20H supplementation great potential to alleviated negative effect caused by soy protein in fish, thus improving the growth performance and fillets quality of cultured fishes.
statement: 膳食补充纳米肽CMCS-20H具有缓解大豆蛋白对鱼类负面影响的潜力，从而改善养殖鱼类的生长性能和鱼肉品质。
text_zh: 膳食补充纳米肽CMCS-20H具有缓解大豆蛋白对鱼类负面影响的潜力，从而改善养殖鱼类的生长性能和鱼肉品质。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with nano-peptide CMCS-20H has the potential to alleviate the negative effects of soybean protein on fish, thereby improving the growth performance and flesh quality of farmed fish.

quote: Chinese perch fed on artificial diet have been successfully domesticated through special procedures ( 20 , 21 ).
statement: 通过特殊程序，已成功驯化摄食人工饲料的鳜鱼。
text_zh: 通过特殊程序，已成功驯化摄食人工饲料的鳜鱼。
text_en: Through a special procedure, mandarin fish that feed on artificial feed have been successfully domesticated.

quote: However, the series of side effects caused by excessive substitution of fish meal with soybean meal have not been fully resolved.
statement: 然而，由过量使用豆粕替代鱼粉引起的一系列副作用尚未完全解决。
text_zh: 然而，由过量使用豆粕替代鱼粉引起的一系列副作用尚未完全解决。
text_en: However, a series of side effects caused by the excessive use of soybean meal to replace fishmeal have not been completely resolved.
intervention: Excessive replacement of fishmeal with soybean meal

quote: After SM was used instead of FM, dietary 160 mg/Kg C-I20 supplementation help to increase intestinal cross-sectional mean area, intestinal villi length, and muscularis thickness, which greatly alleviate the negative effects of SM on intestinal morphology.
statement: 在豆粕（SM）替代鱼粉（FM）的情况下，日粮中添加160 mg/Kg的C-I20有助于增加肠道横截面积、肠绒毛长度和肌层厚度，从而大大缓解SM对肠道形态的负面影响。
text_zh: 在豆粕（SM）替代鱼粉（FM）的情况下，日粮中添加160 mg/Kg的C-I20有助于增加肠道横截面积、肠绒毛长度和肌层厚度，从而大大缓解SM对肠道形态的负面影响。
text_en: In the case of soybean meal (SM) replacing fish meal (FM), adding 160 mg/Kg of C-I20 to the diet helps increase intestinal cross-sectional area, villus length and muscle layer thickness, thereby greatly alleviating the negative effects of SM on intestinal morphology.

quote: The 320 mg/Kg or 160 mg/Kg C-I20 treatment significantly reduces multi-type viscera injury
statement: 320 mg/Kg或160 mg/Kg的C-I20处理显著减少了多类型内脏损伤。
text_zh: 320 mg/Kg或160 mg/Kg的C-I20处理显著减少了多类型内脏损伤。
text_en: C-I20 treatment at 320 mg/Kg or 160 mg/Kg significantly reduced multi-type visceral damage.

quote: During the 10 weeks feeding trial, each of the six experimental diets was fed to fish two times daily (8: 00 and 18: 00).
statement: 在为期10周的饲养试验中，六种实验日粮每天两次（8:00和18:00）投喂给鱼。
text_zh: 在为期10周的饲养试验中，六种实验日粮每天两次（8:00和18:00）投喂给鱼。
text_en: In a 10-week feeding trial, six experimental diets were fed to the fish twice daily (at 8:00 and 18:00).

quote: Fish were fed to satiation, and uneaten food on the disc was carefully removed by siphoning after fed 40 min, which was appropriately adjusted according to the weather, temperature and feeding behavior to ensure the fish were fed to satiation.
statement: 鱼被投喂至饱食，投喂40分钟后通过虹吸法仔细清除盘上的残饵，并根据天气、温度和摄食行为进行适当调整以确保鱼只吃到饱。
text_zh: 鱼被投喂至饱食，投喂40分钟后通过虹吸法仔细清除盘上的残饵，并根据天气、温度和摄食行为进行适当调整以确保鱼只吃到饱。
text_en: Fish are fed to satiation, and 40 minutes after feeding, leftover feed on the plates is carefully removed by siphoning, with appropriate adjustments made according to weather, temperature, and feeding behavior to ensure that fish eat only until satiated.

quote: No deaths were reported throughout the feeding period
statement: 在整个饲喂期间未报告死亡情况。
text_zh: 在整个饲喂期间未报告死亡情况。
text_en: No mortality was reported throughout the entire feeding period.

quote: No discernible variation in VSI and HSI was obtained in all of the experimental diets.
statement: 所有实验日粮的内脏指数和肝体指数没有明显变化。
text_zh: 所有实验日粮的内脏指数和肝体指数没有明显变化。
text_en: There was no significant change in the visceral index and hepatosomatic index of all experimental diets.

quote: The intestinal goblet cell number and mucin thickness were analyzed by PAS staining. Overall, the number of goblet cells and mucin thickness increased with increasing C-I20 dose as measured by PAS staining ( Figure 2A ).
statement: 通过PAS染色分析发现，随着C-I20剂量的增加，肠道杯状细胞数量和黏液厚度均增加。
text_zh: 通过PAS染色分析发现，随着C-I20剂量的增加，肠道杯状细胞数量和黏液厚度均增加。
text_en: PAS staining analysis revealed that as the dose of C-I20 increased, both the number of intestinal goblet cells and mucus thickness increased.

quote: By statistical analysis, the number of goblet cells and mucins on intestinal villi increased significantly in the 320 mg/Kg group compared with the other groups ( Figures 2B, C ).
statement: 统计分析显示，320 mg/Kg组的肠绒毛上杯状细胞和黏液数量显著高于其他组。
text_zh: 统计分析显示，320 mg/Kg组的肠绒毛上杯状细胞和黏液数量显著高于其他组。
text_en: Statistical analysis showed that the number of goblet cells and mucus in the intestinal villi of the 320 mg/Kg group was significantly higher than that of other groups.

quote: The number of goblet cells and mucins on intestinal villi increased significantly in the 160 mg/Kg and FM groups compared with 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg, and control groups, while there was no significant difference between in 160 mg/Kg group and FM group ( Figures 2B, C ).
statement: 与80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg和对照组相比，160 mg/Kg组和FM组的肠绒毛上杯状细胞和黏液数量显著增加，且160 mg/Kg组与FM组之间无显著差异。
text_zh: 与80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg和对照组相比，160 mg/Kg组和FM组的肠绒毛上杯状细胞和黏液数量显著增加，且160 mg/Kg组与FM组之间无显著差异。
text_en: Compared with the 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg, and control groups, the number of goblet cells and mucus in intestinal villi increased significantly in the 160 mg/Kg group and the FM group, and there was no significant difference between the 160 mg/Kg group and the FM group.

quote: In conclusion, dietary 320 mg/Kg or 160 mg/Kg C-I20 supplementation effectively maintains sufficient mucin and goblet cells in intestinal villi to resist the adverse effects of SM.
statement: 结论认为，日粮中添加320 mg/Kg或160 mg/Kg的C-I20能有效维持肠绒毛中足够的黏液和杯状细胞，以抵抗SM的不利影响。
text_zh: 结论认为，日粮中添加320 mg/Kg或160 mg/Kg的C-I20能有效维持肠绒毛中足够的黏液和杯状细胞，以抵抗SM的不利影响。
text_en: The conclusion states that dietary supplementation with 320 mg/Kg or 160 mg/Kg of C-I20 can effectively maintain sufficient mucus and goblet cells in the intestinal villi to resist the adverse effects of SM.

quote: Generally speaking, these data suggest that 160 mg/Kg C-I20 supplementation mainly alleviated the SM-caused increase of feed coefficient and accordingly increased the weight gain rate and crude protein deposition.
statement: 总体而言，这些数据表明160 mg/Kg C-I20补充主要缓解了SM引起的饲料系数增加，并相应提高了增重率和粗蛋白沉积。
text_zh: 总体而言，这些数据表明160 mg/Kg C-I20补充主要缓解了SM引起的饲料系数增加，并相应提高了增重率和粗蛋白沉积。
text_en: Overall, these data indicate that supplementation with 160 mg/Kg C-I20 mainly alleviated the increase in feed conversion ratio caused by SM and correspondingly improved weight gain rate and crude protein deposition.

quote: Through RDA analysis, we found that the goblet cell number and the mucin thickness in each group were negatively correlated with tissue damage indicators to varying degrees ( Figure 5G ).
statement: RDA分析发现，杯状细胞数量和黏液厚度与组织损伤指标呈不同程度的负相关。
text_zh: RDA分析发现，杯状细胞数量和黏液厚度与组织损伤指标呈不同程度的负相关。
text_en: RDA analysis found that goblet cell number and mucus thickness showed varying degrees of negative correlation with tissue damage indicators.
outcome: 肠道黏膜屏障完整性与组织损伤

quote: This indicates that as the number of goblet cells and the thickness of mucin increase, the degree of tissue damage will decrease.
statement: 这表明随着杯状细胞数量和黏液厚度的增加，组织损伤程度会降低。
text_zh: 这表明随着杯状细胞数量和黏液厚度的增加，组织损伤程度会降低。
text_en: This indicates that the degree of tissue damage decreases as the number of goblet cells and mucus thickness increase.

quote: These results show that the dietary 160 mg/Kg C-I20 supplementation reduced vacuole formation, hepatitis serum index (ALT, ALP and AST), renal tubule injury number, and MMC area in head kidney and spleen caused by feeding soybean meal substitute feed.
statement: 结果表明，日粮中添加160 mg/Kg的C-I20减少了由饲喂豆粕替代饲料引起的空泡形成、肝炎血清指数（ALT、ALP和AST）、肾小管损伤数量以及头肾和脾脏中的黑色素巨噬细胞中心面积。
text_zh: 结果表明，日粮中添加160 mg/Kg的C-I20减少了由饲喂豆粕替代饲料引起的空泡形成、肝炎血清指数（ALT、ALP和AST）、肾小管损伤数量以及头肾和脾脏中的黑色素巨噬细胞中心面积。
text_en: The results showed that dietary supplementation with 160 mg/Kg C-I20 reduced vacuolation, hepatitis serum indices (ALT, ALP and AST), the number of renal tubular injuries, and the area of melanomacrophage centers in the head kidney and spleen caused by feeding soybean meal replacement diets.
outcome: 肝脏和肾脏健康及炎症指标

quote: In the intestinal H E staining section, no tissue lesion was observed in any of the groups ( Figure 3A ).
statement: 在肠道HE染色切片中，各组均未观察到组织病变。
text_zh: 在肠道HE染色切片中，各组均未观察到组织病变。
text_en: In intestinal HE-stained sections, no tissue lesions were observed in any group.

quote: Intestinal villus length was markedly longer in the FM and 160 mg/Kg groups than that in the other groups ( Figure 3D ), and muscularis thickness was markedly thicker in FM, 320 mg/Kg, and 160 mg/Kg groups than that in the other groups ( Figure 3E ).
statement: FM组和160 mg/Kg组的肠绒毛长度明显长于其他组，且FM组、320 mg/Kg组和160 mg/Kg组的肌层厚度明显厚于其他组。
text_zh: FM组和160 mg/Kg组的肠绒毛长度明显长于其他组，且FM组、320 mg/Kg组和160 mg/Kg组的肌层厚度明显厚于其他组。
text_en: The intestinal villus length in the FM group and the 160 mg/Kg group was significantly longer than that in the other groups, and the muscle layer thickness in the FM group, the 320 mg/Kg group, and the 160 mg/Kg group was significantly thicker than that in the other groups.

quote: The liver H E staining microimage of the 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg, and control groups showed the most evident liver vacuole formation, whereas the FM, 320 mg/Kg and 160 mg/Kg groups showed the lesser lesions ( Figure 4A ).
statement: 与对照组及低剂量组相比，FM、320 mg/Kg和160 mg/Kg组的鳜鱼肝脏空泡化病变较轻。
text_zh: 与对照组及低剂量组相比，FM、320 mg/Kg和160 mg/Kg组的鳜鱼肝脏空泡化病变较轻。
text_en: Compared with the control group and the low-dose group, liver vacuolation lesions in mandarin fish were milder in the FM, 320 mg/Kg, and 160 mg/Kg groups.

quote: The results of serum activity detection that reflected liver inflammation showed the ALT, ALP and AST activity in FM, 320 mg/Kg and 160 mg/Kg groups was significantly lower than that in 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg group and control groups ( Figures 4C–E ).
statement: 血清检测显示，FM、320 mg/Kg和160 mg/Kg组的ALT、ALP和AST活性显著低于80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg组和对照组。
text_zh: 血清检测显示，FM、320 mg/Kg和160 mg/Kg组的ALT、ALP和AST活性显著低于80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg组和对照组。
text_en: Serum tests showed that the activities of ALT, ALP and AST in the FM, 320 mg/Kg and 160 mg/Kg groups were significantly lower than those in the 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg groups and the control group.

quote: Based on the negative control diet, C-I20 was added to provide graded levels of antimicrobial peptide at final concentration of 40, 80, 160 and 320 mg/Kg.
statement: 在阴性对照日粮基础上，添加C-I20以提供不同浓度（40、80、160和320 mg/Kg）的抗菌肽。
text_zh: 在阴性对照日粮基础上，添加C-I20以提供不同浓度（40、80、160和320 mg/Kg）的抗菌肽。
text_en: On the basis of a negative control diet, C-I20 was added to provide different concentrations (40, 80, 160 and 320 mg/Kg) of antimicrobial peptides.

quote: The water source in the aquaculture system was from groundwater with relatively stable water temperature.
statement: 养殖系统的水源来自水温相对稳定的地下水。
text_zh: 养殖系统的水源来自水温相对稳定的地下水。
text_en: The water source for the aquaculture system is groundwater with relatively stable temperature.

quote: Each tank (L 1.2 m × W 0.6 m × H 1.0 m with water depth of 0.5 m) was equipped with a 50W air pump providing continuous aeration to each tank, and freshwater was supplied daily from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. at a speed of about 20 L/min.
statement: 每个水箱配备50W气泵进行连续曝气，并每天从上午8点到下午6点以约20 L/min的速度供应淡水。
text_zh: 每个水箱配备50W气泵进行连续曝气，并每天从上午8点到下午6点以约20 L/min的速度供应淡水。
text_en: Each tank was equipped with a 50W air pump for continuous aeration, and freshwater was supplied at a rate of about 20 L/min daily from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

quote: During the feeding trial, the water temperature was measured three times from morning to evening, and maintained at 21 ± 0.5°C.
statement: 在饲养试验期间，从早到晚测量三次水温，并维持在21 ± 0.5°C。
text_zh: 在饲养试验期间，从早到晚测量三次水温，并维持在21 ± 0.5°C。
text_en: During the feeding trial, water temperature was measured three times from morning to evening and maintained at 21 ± 0.5°C.

quote: Normally, we change the water once a week and the amount of changed water is about 20%, but as long as the quality index is not up to the standard we will change the water in time.
statement: 通常每周换水一次，换水量约为20%，但如果质量指标不达标则及时换水。
text_zh: 通常每周换水一次，换水量约为20%，但如果质量指标不达标则及时换水。
text_en: Water is usually changed once a week, with a replacement volume of about 20%, but if quality indicators do not meet standards, water is changed promptly.

quote: Before the feeding trial, a total of 540 fish were selected and weighed individually to obtain initial body weight (IBW). The fish were fasted for 24 h and randomly stocked into 18 automatically aerating and circulating tanks.
statement: 试验前选取540尾鱼单独称重以获得初始体重，禁食24小时后随机放入18个自动曝气和循环水箱中。
text_zh: 试验前选取540尾鱼单独称重以获得初始体重，禁食24小时后随机放入18个自动曝气和循环水箱中。
text_en: Before the trial, 540 fish were individually weighed to obtain initial body weight; after 24 hours of fasting, they were randomly placed into 18 automatic aeration and recirculating water tanks.
outcome: 操作应激与分组公平性

quote: Each treatment contained three replicates with 30 fish per tank.
statement: 每个处理包含三个重复，每箱30尾鱼。
text_zh: 每个处理包含三个重复，每箱30尾鱼。
text_en: Each treatment included three replicates, with 30 fish per tank.

quote: Each cage was equipped with a disc of 100 cm in the bottom to collect uneaten food and feces.
statement: 每个笼子底部装有直径100厘米的圆盘，用于收集残饵和粪便。
text_zh: 每个笼子底部装有直径100厘米的圆盘，用于收集残饵和粪便。
text_en: Each cage bottom is equipped with a disc of 100 cm diameter to collect leftover feed and feces.

quote: After feeding trial, twelve fish blood samples in each group were collected for serum biochemistry index firstly, and then the twelve fish tissue (intestine, liver, trunk kidney, spleen, head kidney and muscle) in each group were collected for histological analysis.
statement: 饲养试验结束后，首先采集每组十二条鱼的血液样本进行血清生化指标检测，随后采集每组十二条鱼的组织（肠、肝、躯干肾、脾、头肾和肌肉）进行组织学分析。
text_zh: 饲养试验结束后，首先采集每组十二条鱼的血液样本进行血清生化指标检测，随后采集每组十二条鱼的组织（肠、肝、躯干肾、脾、头肾和肌肉）进行组织学分析。
text_en: After the feeding trial ended, blood samples from twelve fish per group were first collected for serum biochemical indicator detection, followed by collection of tissues (intestine, liver, trunk kidney, spleen, head kidney, and muscle) from twelve fish per group for histological analysis.

quote: Blood samples were collected from the caudal vein and placed for 4 h at 25°C.
statement: 从尾静脉采集血液样本并在25°C下放置4小时。
text_zh: 从尾静脉采集血液样本并在25°C下放置4小时。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the caudal vein and left at 25°C for 4 hours.

quote: In summary, dietary 160 mg/Kg C-I20 prevented the reduction in myofiber diameter and change in fillet texture caused by feeding mandarin fish with soybean protein.
statement: 膳食添加160 mg/Kg C-I20可防止因投喂大豆蛋白导致的鳜鱼肌纤维直径减小和鱼肉质地变化。
text_zh: 膳食添加160 mg/Kg C-I20可防止因投喂大豆蛋白导致的鳜鱼肌纤维直径减小和鱼肉质地变化。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with 160 mg/Kg C-I20 can prevent the reduction in muscle fiber diameter and changes in fish flesh texture caused by feeding soy protein in mandarin fish.
outcome: mitigation of negative effects from soybean meal substitution

quote: By histological analysis, the renal tubule epithelial cells abscission in the trunk kidney were obvious lesions in 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg groups and control group ( Figure 5A ).
statement: 组织学分析显示，在80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg组和对照组中，躯干肾脏肾小管上皮细胞脱落是明显的病变。
text_zh: 组织学分析显示，在80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg组和对照组中，躯干肾脏肾小管上皮细胞脱落是明显的病变。
text_en: Histological analysis showed that sloughing of renal tubular epithelial cells in the trunk kidney was a prominent lesion in the 80 mg/Kg group, the 40 mg/Kg group, and the control group.
intervention: Feed treatment groups vs control (FM, 320, 160 mg/kg)
intervention_record: 饲料处理组与对照组比较（FM、320、160）

quote: Compared with FM group, the augmented MMC area was observed in spleen and head kidney sections of 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg groups and control groups ( Figures 5B, C ).
statement: 与FM组相比，在80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg组和对照组的脾脏和头肾切片中观察到MMC面积增加。
text_zh: 与FM组相比，在80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg组和对照组的脾脏和头肾切片中观察到MMC面积增加。
text_en: Compared with the FM group, increased MMC area was observed in spleen and head kidney sections of the 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg groups and the control group.

quote: In number of injury renal tubule analysis, the number of injury renal tubule in FM, 320 mg/Kg and 160 mg/Kg groups was substantially less than those in the 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg and control groups ( Figure 5D ).
statement: 在受损肾小管数量分析中，FM、320 mg/Kg和160 mg/Kg组的受损肾小管数量显著少于80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg和对照组。
text_zh: 在受损肾小管数量分析中，FM、320 mg/Kg和160 mg/Kg组的受损肾小管数量显著少于80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg和对照组。
text_en: In the analysis of the number of damaged renal tubules, the FM, 320 mg/Kg, and 160 mg/Kg groups had significantly fewer damaged renal tubules than the 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg, and control groups.
intervention_record: 不同剂量饲料处理比较

quote: An appropriate amount of C-I20 has the ability to alleviate the tissue inflammation caused by soybean meal and resist oxidative stress, so the muscle hardness of mandarin fish in the 160 mg/Kg group decreased and the muscle fiber thickened.
statement: 适量C-I20能缓解豆粕引起的组织炎症并抵抗氧化应激，导致鳜鱼肌肉硬度降低和肌纤维增粗。
text_zh: 适量C-I20能缓解豆粕引起的组织炎症并抵抗氧化应激，导致鳜鱼肌肉硬度降低和肌纤维增粗。
text_en: Appropriate amounts of C-I20 can alleviate soybean meal-induced tissue inflammation and resist oxidative stress, resulting in reduced muscle hardness and thickened muscle fibers in mandarin fish.
outcome: 抗氧化应激与抗炎能力

quote: Compared with the 160 mg/kg and 320 mg/kg groups, the 80 mg/kg, 40 mg/kg and control groups showed more severe tissue inflammatory lesions.
statement: 与160 mg/kg和320 mg/kg组相比，80 mg/kg、40 mg/kg和对照组表现出更严重的组织炎症病变。
text_zh: 与160 mg/kg和320 mg/kg组相比，80 mg/kg、40 mg/kg和对照组表现出更严重的组织炎症病变。
text_en: Compared to the 160 mg/kg and 320 mg/kg groups, the 80 mg/kg, 40 mg/kg, and control groups showed more severe tissue inflammatory lesions.

quote: Effects of faba bean ( Vicia faba l. ) on fillet quality of yellow river carp ( Cyprinus carpio ) via the oxidative stress response.
statement: 蚕豆通过氧化应激反应影响黄河鲤鱼的鱼肉品质。
text_zh: 蚕豆通过氧化应激反应影响黄河鲤鱼的鱼肉品质。
text_en: Broad beans affect the flesh quality of Yellow River carp through oxidative stress response.

quote: Carboxymethyl chitosan nanoparticles loaded with bioactive protein CiCXCL20a effectively prevent bacterial disease in grass carp ( Ctenopharyngodon idella ).
statement: 负载生物活性蛋白CiCXCL20a的羧甲基壳聚糖纳米颗粒能有效预防草鱼细菌性疾病。
text_zh: 负载生物活性蛋白CiCXCL20a的羧甲基壳聚糖纳米颗粒能有效预防草鱼细菌性疾病。
text_en: Carboxymethyl chitosan nanoparticles loaded with the bioactive protein CiCXCL20a can effectively prevent bacterial diseases in grass carp.
intervention_record: 载CiCXCL20a羧甲基壳聚糖纳米颗粒

quote: Dietary azomite, a natural trace mineral complex, improved the growth, immunity response, intestine health and resistance against bacterial infection in largemouth bass ( Micropterus salmoid
statement: 饲料中添加天然微量矿物复合物阿佐石改善了大口黑鲈的生长、免疫反应、肠道健康及抗细菌感染能力。
text_zh: 饲料中添加天然微量矿物复合物阿佐石改善了大口黑鲈的生长、免疫反应、肠道健康及抗细菌感染能力。
text_en: The addition of the natural trace mineral complex Azostone to feed improved the growth, immune response, gut health, and resistance to bacterial infection of largemouth bass.
outcome: 生长、免疫、肠道健康及抗病力

quote: For tissue sampling, fish were anaesthetized with MS-222 (40 mg/L, Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA).
statement: 组织取样时，鱼类使用MS-222（40 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 组织取样时，鱼类使用MS-222（40 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_en: For tissue sampling, fish were anesthetized with MS-222 (40 mg/L).
outcome: 操作过程中的疼痛与应激控制

quote: A previous study that added SM to the diet of Atlantic salmon found that excessive amounts of FM substitution with plant protein could harm the liver system ( 36 ).
statement: 先前的研究发现，在大西洋鲑鱼日粮中添加SM时，用植物蛋白过量替代FM可能损害肝脏系统。
text_zh: 先前的研究发现，在大西洋鲑鱼日粮中添加SM时，用植物蛋白过量替代FM可能损害肝脏系统。
text_en: Previous research has found that when SM is added to Atlantic salmon diets, excessive replacement of FM with plant protein may damage the liver system.
intervention: Excessive replacement of FM with plant protein
intervention_record: 植物蛋白过量替代鱼粉

quote: This may be caused by the direct damage to liver cells caused by antinutrition factors entering the blood.
statement: 这种损害可能是由抗营养因子进入血液直接损伤肝细胞引起的。
text_zh: 这种损害可能是由抗营养因子进入血液直接损伤肝细胞引起的。
text_en: This damage may be caused by antinutritional factors entering the blood and directly damaging liver cells.

quote: As can be observed, groups receiving FM, 320 mg/kg and 160 mg/kg inflict less liver damage than the other groups.
statement: 接受FM、320 mg/kg和160 mg/kg处理的组造成的肝损伤少于其他组。
text_zh: 接受FM、320 mg/kg和160 mg/kg处理的组造成的肝损伤少于其他组。
text_en: The groups treated with FM, 320 mg/kg, and 160 mg/kg caused less liver damage than the other groups.

quote: Vacuole formation in the FM, 320 mg/kg and 160 mg/kg groups was less than that in the 80 mg/kg, 40 mg/kg and control groups.
statement: FM、320 mg/kg和160 mg/kg组的液泡形成少于80 mg/kg、40 mg/kg和对照组。
text_en: FM、320 mg/kg和160 mg/kg组的液泡形成少于80 mg/kg、40 mg/kg和对照组。
outcome: 肝脏组织病理学（液泡形成）

quote: The reason for this result may be that the FM, 320 mg/kg and 160 mg/kg groups had an appropriate mucosal barrier to resist the invasion of anti-nutritional factors.
statement: 这一结果的原因可能是FM、320 mg/kg和160 mg/kg组具有适当的黏膜屏障以抵抗抗营养因子的入侵。
text_zh: 这一结果的原因可能是FM、320 mg/kg和160 mg/kg组具有适当的黏膜屏障以抵抗抗营养因子的入侵。
text_en: The reason for this result may be that the FM, 320 mg/kg and 160 mg/kg groups had an appropriate mucosal barrier to resist the invasion of anti-nutritional factors.

quote: ALT, ALP and AST concentrations in serum can rise as a result of liver injury ( 37 ).
statement: 血清中ALT、ALP和AST浓度可因肝损伤而升高。
text_zh: 血清中ALT、ALP和AST浓度可因肝损伤而升高。
text_en: Serum ALT, ALP and AST concentrations may increase due to liver damage.

quote: The activity of ALT, ALP and AST in groups 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg and control was significantly higher than that in the other groups.
statement: 80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg和对照组的ALT、ALP和AST活性显著高于其他组。
text_zh: 80 mg/Kg、40 mg/Kg和对照组的ALT、ALP和AST活性显著高于其他组。
text_en: The ALT, ALP, and AST activities in the 80 mg/Kg, 40 mg/Kg, and control groups were significantly higher than those in the other groups.
outcome: 血清酶活性（肝损伤指标）

quote: The immediate cause for this result is liver tissue produces a large number of cell vacuoles and releases a large number of ALT, ALP and AST into serum.
statement: 这一结果的直接原因是肝组织产生大量细胞液泡并将大量ALT、ALP和AST释放到血清中。
text_zh: 这一结果的直接原因是肝组织产生大量细胞液泡并将大量ALT、ALP和AST释放到血清中。
text_en: The direct cause of this result is that liver tissue produces a large number of cell vacuoles and releases large amounts of ALT, ALP, and AST into the serum.

quote: With the development of a high-density cultural mode in mandarin fish, viral diseases have increased and seriously restricted the development of aquaculture, such as ranavirus and rhabdovirus.
statement: 高密度养殖模式的发展导致鳜鱼病毒性疾病增加，严重限制了水产养殖业的发展。
text_zh: 高密度养殖模式的发展导致鳜鱼病毒性疾病增加，严重限制了水产养殖业的发展。
text_en: The development of high-density farming models has led to an increase in viral diseases in mandarin fish, severely limiting the development of aquaculture.

quote: However, a mucin layer that is too thick may affect the intestinal digestion and absorption function ( 33 ).
statement: 然而，过厚的黏液层可能会影响肠道的消化和吸收功能。
text_zh: 然而，过厚的黏液层可能会影响肠道的消化和吸收功能。
text_en: However, an excessively thick mucus layer may affect the digestive and absorptive functions of the intestine.

quote: Therefore, 160 mg/kg C-I20 treatments with similar mucin thickness to FM treatment might be a suitable feeding strategy.
statement: 因此，与FM处理具有相似黏蛋白厚度的160 mg/kg C-I20处理可能是一种合适的喂养策略。
text_zh: 因此，与FM处理具有相似黏蛋白厚度的160 mg/kg C-I20处理可能是一种合适的喂养策略。
text_en: Therefore, the 160 mg/kg C-I20 treatment, which has a similar mucus thickness to the FM treatment, may be a suitable feeding strategy.

quote: In this study, mandarin fish fed diets with 160 mg/kg C-I20 showed increased villus height.
statement: 在本研究中，喂食含160 mg/kg C-I20日粮的鳜鱼表现出绒毛高度增加。
text_zh: 在本研究中，喂食含160 mg/kg C-I20日粮的鳜鱼表现出绒毛高度增加。
text_en: In this study, mandarin fish fed a diet containing 160 mg/kg C-I20 showed increased villus height.

quote: In this study, supplementary doses below 160 mg/kg had limited positive effects on mandarin fish.
statement: 在本研究中，低于160 mg/kg的补充剂量对鳜鱼的正向作用有限。
text_zh: 在本研究中，低于160 mg/kg的补充剂量对鳜鱼的正向作用有限。
text_en: In this study, supplemental doses below 160 mg/kg had limited positive effects on mandarin fish.

quote: The reason for this result was that the fish fed with 160 mg/kg C-I20 had an appropriate mucosal barrier and organs to promote growth.
statement: 这一结果的原因是喂食160 mg/kg C-I20的鱼具有适当的黏膜屏障和器官以促进生长。
text_zh: 这一结果的原因是喂食160 mg/kg C-I20的鱼具有适当的黏膜屏障和器官以促进生长。
text_en: The reason for this result is that fish fed 160 mg/kg C-I20 had appropriate mucosal barriers and organs to promote growth.

quote: The intestinal barrier could effectively prevent anti-nutritional factors from damaging the intestinal digestive system and promote the growth of fish ( 32 ).
statement: 肠道屏障能有效防止抗营养因子损害肠道消化系统并促进鱼类生长。
text_zh: 肠道屏障能有效防止抗营养因子损害肠道消化系统并促进鱼类生长。
text_en: The intestinal barrier can effectively prevent anti-nutritional factors from damaging the intestinal digestive system and promote fish growth.

quote: The thickness of mucin and the number of goblet cells in the 80, 40 and 0 mg/kg groups were significantly reduced in comparison to the 320 and 160 mg/kg groups.
statement: 与320和160 mg/kg组相比，80、40和0 mg/kg组的黏液厚度和杯状细胞数量显著减少。
text_zh: 与320和160 mg/kg组相比，80、40和0 mg/kg组的黏液厚度和杯状细胞数量显著减少。
text_en: Compared to the 320 and 160 mg/kg groups, mucus thickness and goblet cell number were significantly reduced in the 80, 40, and 0 mg/kg groups.

quote: The relative decrease in mucin and goblet cells in the low-dose group may be due to the long-term damage to the intestinal mucosa caused by anti-nutritional factors in plant proteins ( 4 ).
statement: 低剂量组中黏液和杯状细胞的相对减少可能是由于植物蛋白中的抗营养因子对肠黏膜造成的长期损伤所致。
text_zh: 低剂量组中黏液和杯状细胞的相对减少可能是由于植物蛋白中的抗营养因子对肠黏膜造成的长期损伤所致。
text_en: The relative reduction in mucus and goblet cells in the low-dose group may be due to long-term damage to the intestinal mucosa caused by anti-nutritional factors in plant proteins.

quote: The thickening of mucin in the high-dose feeding group can resist the damage of irritants to maintain the normal function of the intestinal tract.
statement: 高剂量饲喂组中黏液的增厚可以抵抗刺激物的损害以维持肠道的正常功能。
text_zh: 高剂量饲喂组中黏液的增厚可以抵抗刺激物的损害以维持肠道的正常功能。
text_en: In the high-dose feeding group, thickening of mucus can resist damage from irritants to maintain normal intestinal function.

quote: 160 mg/Kg C-I20 treatment effectively improves intestinal mucosal barrier, intestinal morphology and reduces multi-type tissue (liver, trunk kidney, head kidney and spleen) injury.
statement: 160 mg/Kg C-I20处理有效改善肠黏膜屏障、肠道形态，并减少多种组织（肝脏、躯干肾、头肾和脾脏）损伤。
text_zh: 160 mg/Kg C-I20处理有效改善肠黏膜屏障、肠道形态，并减少多种组织（肝脏、躯干肾、头肾和脾脏）损伤。
text_en: 160 mg/Kg C-I20 treatment effectively improved intestinal mucosal barrier and intestinal morphology, and reduced damage in multiple tissues (liver, trunk kidney, head kidney and spleen).
outcome: 肠道健康与器官完整性

quote: For example, it is difficult to regulate water quality, which can easily lead to diseases, thereby affecting the growth rate and muscle quality of mandarin fish
statement: 传统池塘养殖系统难以调节水质，这容易导致疾病，进而影响鳜鱼的生长速度和肌肉品质。
text_zh: 传统池塘养殖系统难以调节水质，这容易导致疾病，进而影响鳜鱼的生长速度和肌肉品质。
text_en: Traditional pond aquaculture systems are difficult to regulate water quality, which easily leads to disease, thereby affecting the growth rate and muscle quality of mandarin fish.

quote: In the TPAS, mandarin fish were stocked at a density of 2 fish per cubic meter and reared in an earthen pond relying on natural water, with the temperature fluctuating seasonally between 18 and 30 °C.
statement: 传统池塘养殖系统（TPAS）中，鳜鱼的放养密度为每立方米2尾，在依赖自然水的土塘中饲养，温度随季节在18至30°C之间波动。
text_zh: 传统池塘养殖系统（TPAS）中，鳜鱼的放养密度为每立方米2尾，在依赖自然水的土塘中饲养，温度随季节在18至30°C之间波动。
text_en: In the Traditional Pond Aquaculture System (TPAS), mandarin fish are stocked at a density of 2 fish per cubic meter, reared in earthen ponds relying on natural water, with temperatures fluctuating seasonally between 18 and 30°C.

quote: In contrast, the RAS maintained a high-density culture of 20 fish per cubic meter within an indoor, fully controlled environment.
statement: 相比之下，循环水养殖系统（RAS）在室内全控环境中维持每立方米20尾的高密度养殖。
text_zh: 相比之下，循环水养殖系统（RAS）在室内全控环境中维持每立方米20尾的高密度养殖。
text_en: In contrast, the Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) maintains a high-density stocking of 20 fish per cubic meter in an indoor fully controlled environment.

quote: The water quality in the RAS was rigorously managed: temperature was kept constant at 25–28 °C, with dissolved oxygen above 5 mg/L, pH between 7.2 and 8.3, and ammonia nitrogen and nitrite levels controlled below 2.0 mg/L and 1.0 mg/L, respectively.
statement: 循环水养殖系统中的水质经过严格管理，温度恒定在25–28°C，溶解氧高于5 mg/L，pH值在7.2至8.3之间，氨氮和亚硝酸盐水平分别控制在低于2.0 mg/L和1.0 mg/L。
text_zh: 循环水养殖系统中的水质经过严格管理，温度恒定在25–28°C，溶解氧高于5 mg/L，pH值在7.2至8.3之间，氨氮和亚硝酸盐水平分别控制在低于2.0 mg/L和1.0 mg/L。
text_en: In the recirculating aquaculture system, water quality is strictly managed, with temperature maintained at a constant 25–28°C, dissolved oxygen above 5 mg/L, pH between 7.2 and 8.3, and ammonia nitrogen and nitrite levels controlled below 2.0 mg/L and 1.0 mg/L, respectively.

quote: In both systems, fish were fed to apparent saturation twice daily (at 6:00–7:00 and 17:00–18:00) with a commercial extruded compound feed formulated specifically for mandarin fish.
statement: 在两种系统中，鱼类每天两次（6:00–7:00和17:00–18:00）投喂至表观饱食状态，使用专为鳜鱼配制的商业挤压配合饲料。
text_zh: 在两种系统中，鱼类每天两次（6:00–7:00和17:00–18:00）投喂至表观饱食状态，使用专为鳜鱼配制的商业挤压配合饲料。
text_en: In both systems, fish were fed to apparent satiation twice daily (6:00–7:00 and 17:00–18:00) using commercial extruded formulated feed specifically prepared for mandarin fish.

population.system: 池塘/传统养殖与循环水养殖

quote: Mandarin fish were euthanized by delivering a quick, forceful blow to the head with a blunt object.
statement: 鳜鱼通过用钝器快速有力地击打头部进行安乐死。
text_zh: 鳜鱼通过用钝器快速有力地击打头部进行安乐死。
text_en: Mandarin fish are euthanized by rapidly and forcefully striking the head with a blunt instrument.

quote: Gut microbiota profiling indicated higher diversity and enriched beneficial genera (e.g., Cetobacterium , Lactobacillus ) in RAS-treated fish.
statement: 肠道微生物群分析表明，经循环水养殖系统处理的鱼类具有更高的多样性以及富集的有益菌属（如鲸杆菌属、乳杆菌属）。
text_zh: 肠道微生物群分析表明，经循环水养殖系统处理的鱼类具有更高的多样性以及富集的有益菌属（如鲸杆菌属、乳杆菌属）。
text_en: Gut microbiota analysis showed that fish raised in recirculating aquaculture systems had higher diversity and enriched beneficial bacterial genera (such as Cetobacterium and Lactobacillus).

population.system: 工业化循环水养殖系统 vs 传统池塘养殖系统

quote: These factors may promote protein synthesis and deposition while reducing the conversion of energy into fat.
statement: RAS中的溶解氧、温度、氨氮等环境因素及优化投喂策略可能促进蛋白质合成与沉积，同时减少能量转化为脂肪。
text_zh: RAS中的溶解氧、温度、氨氮等环境因素及优化投喂策略可能促进蛋白质合成与沉积，同时减少能量转化为脂肪。
text_en: Environmental factors such as dissolved oxygen, temperature, and ammonia nitrogen in RAS, along with optimized feeding strategies, may promote protein synthesis and deposition while reducing the conversion of energy into fat.

quote: The RAS environment typically features more controllable water quality parameters (such as dissolved oxygen, temperature, and ammonia nitrogen), lower environmental stress, and optimized feeding strategies.
statement: 循环水养殖系统（RAS）环境通常具有更可控的水质参数（如溶解氧、温度和氨氮）、更低的环境压力和优化的喂养策略。
text_zh: 循环水养殖系统（RAS）环境通常具有更可控的水质参数（如溶解氧、温度和氨氮）、更低的环境压力和优化的喂养策略。
text_en: Recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) environments typically have more controllable water quality parameters (such as dissolved oxygen, temperature, and ammonia nitrogen), lower environmental stress, and optimized feeding strategies.

quote: At the same time, it uses an intelligent monitoring system to regulate key parameters in real time, such as water temperature and dissolved oxygen, simulating natural water quality and creating an excellent growth environment for mandarin fish.
statement: 该系统使用智能监控系统实时调节水温、溶解氧等关键参数，模拟自然水质，为鳜鱼创造优良的生长环境。
text_zh: 该系统使用智能监控系统实时调节水温、溶解氧等关键参数，模拟自然水质，为鳜鱼创造优良的生长环境。
text_en: The system uses an intelligent monitoring system to adjust key parameters such as water temperature and dissolved oxygen in real time, simulating natural water quality to create a favorable growth environment for mandarin fish.

quote: Land-based circular bucket recirculating aquaculture technology, combined with the Internet of Things intelligent technology, not only improves the utilization rate of aquaculture space but also enables precise control of the aquaculture process.
statement: 陆基圆桶循环水养殖技术结合物联网智能技术，不仅提高了养殖空间利用率，还实现了养殖过程的精确控制。
text_zh: 陆基圆桶循环水养殖技术结合物联网智能技术，不仅提高了养殖空间利用率，还实现了养殖过程的精确控制。
text_en: Land-based circular tank recirculating aquaculture technology combined with IoT smart technology not only improves the utilization rate of farming space but also achieves precise control of the farming process.
intervention: Land-based circular tank RAS with IoT
intervention_record: 陆基圆桶循环水结合物联网

quote: However, the differential impacts of these systems on mandarin fish growth performance, muscle quality, and economic viability remain inadequately characterized.
statement: 然而，这些系统对鳜鱼生长性能、肌肉品质和经济可行性的差异化影响尚未得到充分表征。
text_zh: 然而，这些系统对鳜鱼生长性能、肌肉品质和经济可行性的差异化影响尚未得到充分表征。
text_en: However, the differential effects of these systems on the growth performance, muscle quality, and economic feasibility of mandarin fish have not been fully characterized.

quote: The results of the Simpson diversity index indicate that the microbial diversity of the RAS group is significantly higher than that of the TPAS group ( p 0.05), suggesting that the RAS improved the alpha diversity of the intestinal microbiota of mandarin fish.
statement: Simpson多样性指数显示RAS组的微生物多样性显著高于TPAS组，表明循环水养殖系统（RAS）改善了鳜鱼肠道菌群的α多样性。
text_zh: Simpson多样性指数显示RAS组的微生物多样性显著高于TPAS组，表明循环水养殖系统（RAS）改善了鳜鱼肠道菌群的α多样性。
text_en: The Simpson diversity index showed that microbial diversity in the RAS group was significantly higher than in the TPAS group, indicating that the recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) improved the alpha diversity of the gut microbiota of mandarin fish.

quote: In general, the TPAS group had a higher relative abundance of conditional pathogens and a lower relative abundance of beneficial bacteria, indicating that the intestinal homeostasis and health of mandarin fish may have been damaged to a certain extent.
statement: TPAS组条件致病菌相对丰度较高而有益菌相对丰度较低，表明鳜鱼的肠道稳态和健康可能在一定程度上受到损害。
text_zh: TPAS组条件致病菌相对丰度较高而有益菌相对丰度较低，表明鳜鱼的肠道稳态和健康可能在一定程度上受到损害。
text_en: The relative abundance of opportunistic pathogens in the TPAS group was higher, while that of beneficial bacteria was lower, indicating that the intestinal homeostasis and health of mandarin fish may have been impaired to some extent.
outcome: 肠道菌群结构与健康状态

quote: On the contrary, the RAS group had a lower relative abundance of conditional pathogens and a higher relative abundance of beneficial bacteria, suggesting that this aquaculture model can effectively shape the intestinal flora and improve disease resistance.
statement: 相反，RAS组条件致病菌相对丰度较低而有益菌相对丰度较高，表明该养殖模式能有效塑造肠道菌群并提高抗病力。
text_zh: 相反，RAS组条件致病菌相对丰度较低而有益菌相对丰度较高，表明该养殖模式能有效塑造肠道菌群并提高抗病力。
text_en: In contrast, the RAS group had a lower relative abundance of opportunistic pathogens and a higher relative abundance of beneficial bacteria, indicating that this farming model can effectively shape the gut microbiota and improve disease resistance.
outcome: 肠道菌群结构与抗病力

quote: both groups exhibited high activity in the “Metabolism” pathway, but the TPAS group showed more complexity in pathways related to “Human Diseases,” consistent with the potential mechanism of inflammation induced by opportunistic pathogens.
statement: 两组在“代谢”通路中均表现出高活性，但TPAS组在与“人类疾病”相关的通路中显示出更多复杂性，这与机会性病原体诱导炎症的潜在机制一致。
text_zh: 两组在“代谢”通路中均表现出高活性，但TPAS组在与“人类疾病”相关的通路中显示出更多复杂性，这与机会性病原体诱导炎症的潜在机制一致。
text_en: Both groups showed high activity in the "Metabolism" pathway, but the TPAS group displayed more complexity in pathways related to "Human Diseases," which is consistent with the potential mechanism of inflammation induced by opportunistic pathogens.
outcome: 肠道微生物功能通路与炎症风险

quote: The Level2 pathway heatmap indicated that the TPAS group was more active in stress- and disease-related pathways such as “Environmental Adaptation,” “Endocrine and Metabolic Diseases,” and “Antibiotic Resistance.”
statement: Level2通路热图显示，TPAS组在“环境适应”、“内分泌和代谢疾病”及“抗生素耐药性”等应激和疾病相关通路中更为活跃。
text_zh: Level2通路热图显示，TPAS组在“环境适应”、“内分泌和代谢疾病”及“抗生素耐药性”等应激和疾病相关通路中更为活跃。
text_en: The Level2 pathway heatmap shows that the TPAS group was more active in stress- and disease-related pathways such as "Environmental adaptation", "Endocrine and metabolic diseases", and "Antibiotic resistance".
outcome: 应激反应与疾病相关代谢通路

quote: Therefore, the lower abundance of Bacteroidetes in the RAS group may contribute to improved fish health.
statement: 循环水养殖系统（RAS）组中拟杆菌门丰度较低可能有助于改善鱼类健康。
text_zh: 循环水养殖系统（RAS）组中拟杆菌门丰度较低可能有助于改善鱼类健康。
text_en: The lower abundance of Bacteroidetes in the Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) group may help improve fish health.

quote: At the genus level, the relative abundances of Mycobacterium , Clostridium , and Staphylococcus in the intestinal flora of mandarin fish in the RAS group decreased, while the relative abundances of Cetobacterium and Mesomycoplasma increased.
statement: 在属水平上，循环水养殖系统组鳜鱼肠道菌群中分枝杆菌、梭菌和葡萄球菌的相对丰度降低，而鲸杆菌和中支原体相对丰度增加。
text_zh: 在属水平上，循环水养殖系统组鳜鱼肠道菌群中分枝杆菌、梭菌和葡萄球菌的相对丰度降低，而鲸杆菌和中支原体相对丰度增加。
text_en: At the genus level, in the gut microbiota of mandarin fish in the recirculating aquaculture system group, the relative abundance of Mycobacterium, Clostridium, and Staphylococcus decreased, while the relative abundance of Cetobacterium and Mesoplasma increased.

quote: The results indicated that under the RAS, the relative abundances of potential pathogenic genera (such as Mycobacterium , pathogenic species of Clostridium , and Staphylococcus ) in the intestines of mandarin fish were significantly reduced.
statement: 结果表明，在循环水养殖系统下，鳜鱼肠道中潜在致病菌属（如分枝杆菌、致病性梭菌和葡萄球菌）的相对丰度显著降低。
text_zh: 结果表明，在循环水养殖系统下，鳜鱼肠道中潜在致病菌属（如分枝杆菌、致病性梭菌和葡萄球菌）的相对丰度显著降低。
text_en: The results showed that under a recirculating aquaculture system, the relative abundance of potential pathogenic genera in the gut of mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi), such as Mycobacterium, pathogenic Clostridium, and Staphylococcus, was significantly reduced.

quote: This change is most likely directly related to the strict water quality management (e.g., efficient filtration and disinfection) and robust biosecurity measures in the RAS, which significantly reduce the pathogenic load and transmission risk in the environment, thereby effectively lowering the risk of mandarin fish contracting intractable bacterial diseases (such as mycobacteriosis) and intestinal or systemic diseases caused by opportunistic pathogens (such as pathogenic Clostridium and Staphylococcus ).
statement: 这种变化很可能直接归因于循环水养殖系统中严格的水质管理（如高效过滤和消毒）和强有力的生物安全措施，这些措施显著降低了环境中的病原负荷和传播风险，从而有效降低了鳜鱼感染顽固性细菌性疾病（如结核病）以及由机会性病原体（如致病性梭菌和葡萄球菌）引起的肠道或全身性疾病的风险。
text_zh: 这种变化很可能直接归因于循环水养殖系统中严格的水质管理（如高效过滤和消毒）和强有力的生物安全措施，这些措施显著降低了环境中的病原负荷和传播风险，从而有效降低了鳜鱼感染顽固性细菌性疾病（如结核病）以及由机会性病原体（如致病性梭菌和葡萄球菌）引起的肠道或全身性疾病的风险。
text_en: This change is likely directly attributable to strict water quality management (such as high-efficiency filtration and disinfection) and strong biosecurity measures in the recirculating aquaculture system, which significantly reduced the pathogen load and transmission risk in the environment, thereby effectively reducing the risk of mandarin fish infection with stubborn bacterial diseases (such as tuberculosis) and intestinal or systemic diseases caused by opportunistic pathogens (such as pathogenic Clostridium and Staphylococcus).
intervention: Water quality management and biosecurity measures
intervention_record: 水质管理与生物安全措施

quote: The enrichment of beneficial bacteria in the RAS group and their involvement in pathways such as carbon metabolism and amino acid biosynthesis not only enhanced the host’s nutritional metabolism and energy utilization efficiency but also contributed to promoting protein deposition and the accumulation of flavor-related amino acids (e.g., Gly and Pro), while simultaneously inhibiting lipid peroxidation and the formation of fishy aldehydes.
statement: RAS组中有益菌的富集及其在碳代谢和氨基酸生物合成等途径中的作用，不仅增强了宿主的营养代谢和能量利用效率，还促进了蛋白质沉积和风味相关氨基酸（如甘氨酸和脯氨酸）的积累，同时抑制了脂质过氧化和鱼腥味醛类的形成。
text_zh: RAS组中有益菌的富集及其在碳代谢和氨基酸生物合成等途径中的作用，不仅增强了宿主的营养代谢和能量利用效率，还促进了蛋白质沉积和风味相关氨基酸（如甘氨酸和脯氨酸）的积累，同时抑制了脂质过氧化和鱼腥味醛类的形成。
text_en: The enrichment of beneficial bacteria in the RAS group and their role in pathways such as carbon metabolism and amino acid biosynthesis not only enhanced host nutritional metabolism and energy utilization efficiency, but also promoted protein deposition and the accumulation of flavor-related amino acids (such as glycine and proline), while simultaneously inhibiting lipid peroxidation and the formation of fishy-smelling aldehydes.

population.system: 循环水养殖系统 (RAS) vs 传统池塘养殖系统 (TPAS)

quote: Effect of ozone and hydrogen peroxide on off-flavor compounds and water quality in a recirculating aquaculture system.
statement: 臭氧和过氧化氢对循环水养殖系统中的异味化合物和水质有影响。
text_zh: 臭氧和过氧化氢对循环水养殖系统中的异味化合物和水质有影响。
text_en: Ozone and hydrogen peroxide affect off-flavor compounds and water quality in recirculating aquaculture systems.

quote: Simultaneously, the relative abundance of Cetobacterium in the intestines of mandarin fish under the RAS increased significantly.
statement: 在循环水养殖系统（RAS）下，鳜鱼肠道中Cetobacterium的相对丰度显著增加。
text_zh: 在循环水养殖系统（RAS）下，鳜鱼肠道中Cetobacterium的相对丰度显著增加。
text_en: Under the Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS), the relative abundance of Cetobacterium in the gut of mandarin fish increased significantly.

quote: This significantly promotes intestinal health and may improve feed utilization efficiency (especially adaptation to high-protein feed).
statement: 这显著促进了肠道健康，并可能提高饲料利用效率（特别是对高蛋白饲料的适应性）。
text_zh: 这显著促进了肠道健康，并可能提高饲料利用效率（特别是对高蛋白饲料的适应性）。
text_en: This significantly promoted gut health and may improve feed utilization efficiency (especially the adaptability to high-protein feeds).

quote: In our study ( Figure 3 G), the relative abundance of Pseudomonadota in the intestinal microbial community of the TPAS group significantly increased, which may indicate the presence of a certain degree of intestinal inflammatory response in their bodies.
statement: 在本研究中，TPAS组肠道微生物群落中Pseudomonadota的相对丰度显著增加，这可能表明其体内存在一定程度的肠道炎症反应。
text_zh: 在本研究中，TPAS组肠道微生物群落中Pseudomonadota的相对丰度显著增加，这可能表明其体内存在一定程度的肠道炎症反应。
text_en: In this study, the relative abundance of Pseudomonadota in the gut microbial community of the TPAS group increased significantly, which may indicate a certain degree of intestinal inflammatory response in their bodies.

quote: Among stress-resistant microorganisms ( Figure 3 F), the abundance of Bacillota in the RAS group was significantly higher.
statement: 在抗应激微生物中，RAS组的Bacillota丰度显著更高。
text_zh: 在抗应激微生物中，RAS组的Bacillota丰度显著更高。
text_en: Among stress-resistant microorganisms, the abundance of Bacillota was significantly higher in the RAS group.

quote: In contrast, the RAS group was enriched in probiotic-associated pathways such as “Lysine Biosynthesis” and “Carbon Metabolism,” which support nutrient absorption and microecological balance.
statement: 相比之下，RAS组富集了赖氨酸生物合成和碳代谢等益生菌相关通路，这些通路支持营养吸收和微生态平衡。
text_zh: 相比之下，RAS组富集了赖氨酸生物合成和碳代谢等益生菌相关通路，这些通路支持营养吸收和微生态平衡。
text_en: In contrast, the RAS group was enriched in probiotic-related pathways such as lysine biosynthesis and carbon metabolism, which support nutrient absorption and microbiota balance.
outcome: 营养吸收与微生态平衡

quote: In summary, the RAS significantly optimized the structure of the intestinal flora in mandarin fish through its advantages in environmental control: it inhibited the colonization and pathogenic risk of potential pathogens while promoting the proliferation of beneficial symbiotic bacteria represented by Cetobacterium and their metabolic functions (e.g., SCFA production).
statement: RAS通过其环境控制优势显著优化了鳜鱼肠道菌群结构：抑制潜在病原体的定植和致病风险，同时促进以Cetobacterium为代表的有益共生菌的增殖及其代谢功能（如短链脂肪酸产生）。
text_zh: RAS通过其环境控制优势显著优化了鳜鱼肠道菌群结构：抑制潜在病原体的定植和致病风险，同时促进以Cetobacterium为代表的有益共生菌的增殖及其代谢功能（如短链脂肪酸产生）。
text_en: RAS significantly optimized the gut microbiota structure of mandarin fish through its environmental control advantages: inhibiting the colonization and pathogenic risk of potential pathogens, while promoting the proliferation of beneficial symbiotic bacteria represented by Cetobacterium and their metabolic functions (such as short-chain fatty acid production).
outcome: 肠道菌群结构与病原体控制

quote: Combined with functional prediction analysis, the TPAS group exhibited characteristics of high abundance of opportunistic pathogens, low abundance of beneficial bacteria, and active disease-related functional pathways, which may impair intestinal homeostasis in mandarin fish to some extent.
statement: 结合功能预测分析，TPAS组表现出机会性病原体丰度高、有益菌丰度低以及疾病相关功能通路活跃的特征，这在一定程度上可能损害鳜鱼的肠道稳态。
text_zh: 结合功能预测分析，TPAS组表现出机会性病原体丰度高、有益菌丰度低以及疾病相关功能通路活跃的特征，这在一定程度上可能损害鳜鱼的肠道稳态。
text_en: Combined with functional prediction analysis, the TPAS group exhibited characteristics of high abundance of opportunistic pathogens, low abundance of beneficial bacteria, and active disease-related functional pathways, which may impair gut homeostasis in mandarin fish to some extent.

quote: This transformation in microbial structure and function serves as an important microbiological basis for the RAS to improve the health level of mandarin fish, reduce disease incidence, and enhance potential production performance.
statement: 这种微生物结构和功能的转变是RAS改善鳜鱼健康水平、降低疾病发生率并提高潜在生产性能的重要微生物学基础。
text_zh: 这种微生物结构和功能的转变是RAS改善鳜鱼健康水平、降低疾病发生率并提高潜在生产性能的重要微生物学基础。
text_en: This shift in microbial structure and function is an important microbiological basis for RAS improving the health level of mandarin fish, reducing disease incidence, and enhancing potential production performance.
outcome: 健康水平与疾病发生率

quote: Compared to the TPAS group, the microbial community of the RAS group showed significant differences at multiple time points (LDA 4.0, p 0.05).
statement: 与TPAS组相比，RAS组的微生物群落在多个时间点显示出显著差异（LDA 4.0, p < 0.05）。
text_zh: 与TPAS组相比，RAS组的微生物群落在多个时间点显示出显著差异（LDA 4.0, p < 0.05）。
text_en: Compared to the TPAS group, the microbial communities in the RAS group showed significant differences at multiple time points (LDA 4.0, p < 0.05).

quote: Conversely, TPAS fish exhibited higher abundances of potential pathogens and inflammation-related metabolic pathways.
statement: 相比之下，传统池塘养殖系统（TPAS）中的鱼类表现出更高的潜在病原体丰度和炎症相关代谢途径。
text_zh: 相比之下，传统池塘养殖系统（TPAS）中的鱼类表现出更高的潜在病原体丰度和炎症相关代谢途径。
text_en: In contrast, fish in the traditional pond aquaculture system (TPAS) showed higher abundance of potential pathogens and inflammation-related metabolic pathways.

quote: Acute heat shock at 340C resulted in strong upregulation of ScHSP60 in heart, liver, and head kidney in a time-dependent manner.
statement: 急性热休克（34°C）导致心脏、肝脏和头肾中ScHSP60呈时间依赖性显著上调。
text_zh: 急性热休克（34°C）导致心脏、肝脏和头肾中ScHSP60呈时间依赖性显著上调。
text_en: Acute heat shock (34°C) caused a significant time-dependent upregulation of ScHSP60 in the heart, liver, and head kidney.

quote: Various environmental stresses, including high temperature, hypoxia, and Aeromonas hydrophila infection, the causative agent of outbreaks of bacterial hemorrhagic septicemia disease, have frequently threatened the health of this fish, causing serious economic losses to the aquaculture industry (Lao et al. 2008; Chen et al. 2012).
statement: 高温、缺氧和嗜水气单胞菌感染等环境胁迫经常威胁鳜鱼的健康，并给水产养殖业造成严重的经济损失。
text_zh: 高温、缺氧和嗜水气单胞菌感染等环境胁迫经常威胁鳜鱼的健康，并给水产养殖业造成严重的经济损失。
text_en: Environmental stresses such as high temperature, hypoxia, and Aeromonas hydrophila infection frequently threaten the health of mandarin fish and cause severe economic losses to the aquaculture industry.

quote: ScHSP60 was also markedly induced in the liver in a stage-dependent manner under hypoxia.
statement: 在缺氧条件下，ScHSP60在肝脏中以发育阶段依赖的方式被显著诱导。
text_zh: 在缺氧条件下，ScHSP60在肝脏中以发育阶段依赖的方式被显著诱导。
text_en: Under hypoxic conditions, ScHSP60 is significantly induced in the liver in a developmental stage-dependent manner.

quote: Additionally, Aeromonas hydrophila infection augmented ScHSP60 in head kidney and spleen.
statement: 此外，嗜水气单胞菌感染增加了头肾和脾脏中的ScHSP60水平。
text_zh: 此外，嗜水气单胞菌感染增加了头肾和脾脏中的ScHSP60水平。
text_en: In addition, Aeromonas hydrophila infection increased ScHSP60 levels in the head kidney and spleen.

quote: To investigate the expression patterns of ScHSP60 in response to thermal stress, the fish were subjected to three regimes of thermal stress: acute, rapidly elevated, and gradually elevated.
statement: 为了研究ScHSP60对热应激的反应模式，鱼被暴露于三种热应激方案：急性、快速升温和缓慢升温。
text_zh: 为了研究ScHSP60对热应激的反应模式，鱼被暴露于三种热应激方案：急性、快速升温和缓慢升温。
text_en: To study the response pattern of ScHSP60 to heat stress, fish were exposed to three heat stress protocols: acute, rapid heating, and slow heating.

quote: For acute thermal stress, 20 fish (140 ± 20 g, BW) maintained in water at 25°C were carefully and directly shifted to a tank of 2,000 L in the circulating water system at a constant temperature of 34°C.
statement: 在急性热应激中，20条鱼从25°C的水中被小心地直接转移到循环水系统中温度为34°C的2000升水箱内。
text_zh: 在急性热应激中，20条鱼从25°C的水中被小心地直接转移到循环水系统中温度为34°C的2000升水箱内。
text_en: In acute heat stress, 20 fish were carefully transferred directly from water at 25°C to a 2000-liter tank in a recirculating aquaculture system with a temperature of 34°C.

quote: In the other two regimes of thermal stress, fish were transferred to the 2,000 L tank in the circulating water system (initial temperature: 25°C); then the water temperature was elevated from 25 to 38.8°C at an average speed of 1.2°C increase per hour for rapid elevated thermal stress treatment, and 0.2°C increase per hour for gradual elevated thermal stress.
statement: 在其他两种热应激方案中，鱼被转移到初始温度为25°C的循环水系统水箱中；随后水温以每小时平均升高1.2°C的速度从25°C升至38.8°C作为快速升温处理，或以每小时0.2°C的速度升高作为缓慢升温处理。
text_zh: 在其他两种热应激方案中，鱼被转移到初始温度为25°C的循环水系统水箱中；随后水温以每小时平均升高1.2°C的速度从25°C升至38.8°C作为快速升温处理，或以每小时0.2°C的速度升高作为缓慢升温处理。
text_en: In the other two heat stress protocols, fish were transferred to recirculating water system tanks with an initial temperature of 25°C; subsequently, the water temperature was raised from 25°C to 38.8°C at an average rate of 1.2°C per hour as the rapid heating treatment, or at a rate of 0.2°C per hour as the slow heating treatment.
outcome: 慢性/渐进性热应激暴露

quote: Results showed that infection with A. hydrophila significantly (P < 0.01) increased the ScHSP60 expression in the head kidney and spleen.
statement: A. hydrophila感染显著增加了头肾和脾脏中ScHSP60的表达。
text_zh: A. hydrophila感染显著增加了头肾和脾脏中ScHSP60的表达。
text_en: A. hydrophila infection significantly increased the expression of ScHSP60 in the head kidney and spleen.

quote: During the time-course experiment, ScHSP60 mRNA level   initially increased significantly and reached the highest level of 3.2 times in the head kidney at 12 h and gradually decreased to baseline thereafter.
statement: 在时间进程实验中，头肾中的ScHSP60 mRNA水平最初显著增加，在12小时达到最高水平（对照组的3.2倍），随后逐渐下降至基线。
text_zh: 在时间进程实验中，头肾中的ScHSP60 mRNA水平最初显著增加，在12小时达到最高水平（对照组的3.2倍），随后逐渐下降至基线。
text_en: In the time-course experiment, ScHSP60 mRNA levels in the head kidney initially increased significantly, reaching a maximum level at 12 hours (3.2 times that of the control group), and then gradually decreased to baseline.

quote: Although ScHSP60 was not significantly changed in the heart, the mRNA level was markedly increased in the liver by hypoxia in a time-dependent manner, increasing 1.9 and 4.6 times compared with the control group at 6 and 12 h, respectively.
statement: 低氧暴露导致斑鳜肝脏中ScHSP60的mRNA水平呈时间依赖性显著升高，在6小时和12小时分别比对照组增加1.9倍和4.6倍，而心脏中无显著变化。
text_zh: 低氧暴露导致斑鳜肝脏中ScHSP60的mRNA水平呈时间依赖性显著升高，在6小时和12小时分别比对照组增加1.9倍和4.6倍，而心脏中无显著变化。
text_en: Hypoxia exposure caused a significant time-dependent increase in ScHSP60 mRNA levels in the liver of Siniperca chuatsi, increasing by 1.9-fold and 4.6-fold at 6 hours and 12 hours respectively compared to the control group, while there was no significant change in the heart.
outcome: 热休克蛋白表达/应激反应

quote: In addition, the induced ScHSP60 mRNA level after 6h-hypoxia exposure returned to its baseline during re-oxygenation over 24 h.
statement: 经过6小时低氧暴露后诱导产生的ScHSP60 mRNA水平，在随后24小时的复氧过程中恢复至基线水平。
text_zh: 经过6小时低氧暴露后诱导产生的ScHSP60 mRNA水平，在随后24小时的复氧过程中恢复至基线水平。
text_en: The ScHSP60 mRNA levels induced after 6 hours of hypoxia exposure returned to baseline levels during the subsequent 24-hour reoxygenation.
outcome: 热休克蛋白表达/应激恢复

quote: The fish (120 ± 20 g, body weight, BW) were reared in a circulating water system containing a series of 2000 L tanks with water temperature of 25°C for more than two weeks
statement: 鱼在循环水系统中饲养，水温为25°C。
text_zh: 鱼在循环水系统中饲养，水温为25°C。
text_en: Fish were raised in a recirculating aquaculture system at a water temperature of 25°C.

quote: fed fresh juvenile Cirrhinus molitorella at approximately 5% total biomass every day
statement: 每天按总生物量的约5%投喂新鲜的小鲮鱼幼鱼。
text_zh: 每天按总生物量的约5%投喂新鲜的小鲮鱼幼鱼。
text_en: Fresh juvenile mud carp were fed daily at about 5% of the total biomass.

quote: Before tissue collection, ﬁsh were anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, XiangBo Biotec, China).
statement: 在组织采集前，使用三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）对鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在组织采集前，使用三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）对鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222) before tissue collection.

quote: Fertilized eggs were hatched in three vertical ﬁsh egg incubators (BaiRong Aquatic breeding Co., Ltd). Clean, oxygenated water (temperature 27°C) flowed continuously into incubators.
statement: 受精卵在垂直式鱼卵孵化器中孵化，清洁且充氧的水以27°C连续流入孵化器。
text_zh: 受精卵在垂直式鱼卵孵化器中孵化，清洁且充氧的水以27°C连续流入孵化器。
text_en: Fertilized eggs were incubated in a vertical egg incubator, with clean and oxygenated water continuously flowing into the incubator at 27°C.

quote:
Six fish were randomly sampled when the temperature reached 34°C, six
more at 38.8 °C, and another six individuals were maintained at 25°C (control group).
statement: 实验在温度达到34°C和38.8°C时分别随机采样六条鱼，并将另外六条鱼维持在25°C作为对照组。
text_zh: 实验在温度达到34°C和38.8°C时分别随机采样六条鱼，并将另外六条鱼维持在25°C作为对照组。
text_en: The experiment randomly sampled six fish each when the temperature reached 34°C and 38.8°C, and maintained another six fish at 25°C as a control group.

quote:
Forty-eight ﬁsh (132 ± 17 g, BW) acclimated to the normal oxygen
environment (dissolved oxygen, DO: >5.6 mg/L, temperature: 25°C) were randomly
distributed  into eight tanks of 400 L each  (A-D, and A′-D′): A-C, exposed to a low
oxygen level of 0.9 ± 0.1 mg/l of DO for 2, 6 and 12 h, respectively; D, re-oxygenation
under normal oxygen for 24 h after 6-h hypoxia; A′-D′, exposed to normal oxygen, were
referred to as control groups for A-D, respectively.
statement: 四十八条鱼被随机分配到八个水箱中，其中A-C组分别暴露于0.9±0.1 mg/L的低溶解氧水平2、6和12小时，D组在6小时缺氧后复氧24小时，A'-D'组为正常氧气对照。
text_zh: 四十八条鱼被随机分配到八个水箱中，其中A-C组分别暴露于0.9±0.1 mg/L的低溶解氧水平2、6和12小时，D组在6小时缺氧后复氧24小时，A'-D'组为正常氧气对照。
text_en: Forty-eight fish were randomly assigned to eight tanks, in which groups A-C were exposed to a low dissolved oxygen level of 0.9±0.1 mg/L for 2, 6, and 12 hours respectively, group D was reoxygenated for 24 hours after 6 hours of hypoxia, and groups A'-D' served as normal oxygen controls.

quote:
Dissolved oxygen of 0.9 ± 0.1 mg/l
was maintained by controlling water and nitrogen inﬂows.
statement: 通过控制水和氮气的流入来维持0.9±0.1 mg/L的溶解氧水平。
text_zh: 通过控制水和氮气的流入来维持0.9±0.1 mg/L的溶解氧水平。
text_en: Dissolved oxygen levels were maintained at 0.9±0.1 mg/L by controlling the inflow of water and nitrogen gas.

quote:
Each fish was intraperitoneally injected with a total of
0.5 mL of A. hydrophila (5×108 CFU/mL), which was diluted with sterile phosphate buffer
solution (PBS, pH 7.4).
statement: 每条鱼腹腔注射了0.5 mL用无菌磷酸盐缓冲液稀释的嗜水气单胞菌（5×10^8 CFU/mL）。
text_zh: 每条鱼腹腔注射了0.5 mL用无菌磷酸盐缓冲液稀释的嗜水气单胞菌（5×10^8 CFU/mL）。
text_en: Each fish was intraperitoneally injected with 0.5 mL of Aeromonas hydrophila (5×10^8 CFU/mL) diluted in sterile phosphate-buffered saline.

quote: These results suggest that ScHSP60 stimulated immune response to protect fish from damage caused by A. hydrophila.
statement: 这些结果表明，ScHSP60刺激免疫反应以保护鱼类免受嗜水气单胞菌造成的损害。
text_zh: 这些结果表明，ScHSP60刺激免疫反应以保护鱼类免受嗜水气单胞菌造成的损害。
text_en: These results indicate that ScHSP60 stimulates an immune response to protect fish from damage caused by Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote:
Expression profiles found in this study suggest that ScHSP60 is
involved in embryogenesis and the stress responses of high temperature, hypoxia, and
bacterial infection.
statement: 本研究中观察到的表达谱表明，ScHSP60参与胚胎发生以及高温、缺氧和细菌感染的应激反应。
text_zh: 本研究中观察到的表达谱表明，ScHSP60参与胚胎发生以及高温、缺氧和细菌感染的应激反应。
text_en: The expression profile observed in this study indicates that ScHSP60 is involved in embryogenesis and stress responses to high temperature, hypoxia, and bacterial infection.

quote:
The identification and expression analysis of ScHSP60 will benefit to
further clarify the important roles of HSP60 in embryogenesis, complex environmental,
physiological, and stressful conditions in aquatic vertebrates, and contribute to further
studies to enhance stress tolerance and disease resistance of mandarin fish.
statement: ScHSP60的鉴定和表达分析将有助于进一步阐明HSP60在水生脊椎动物胚胎发生、复杂环境、生理和应激条件下的重要作用，并有助于进一步研究以提高鳜鱼的应激耐受性和疾病抵抗力。
text_zh: ScHSP60的鉴定和表达分析将有助于进一步阐明HSP60在水生脊椎动物胚胎发生、复杂环境、生理和应激条件下的重要作用，并有助于进一步研究以提高鳜鱼的应激耐受性和疾病抵抗力。
text_en: The identification and expression analysis of ScHSP60 will help further elucidate the important role of HSP60 in embryogenesis, complex environments, physiology, and stress conditions in aquatic vertebrates, and will help further research to improve the stress tolerance and disease resistance of mandarin fish.
outcome: 应激耐受性/疾病抵抗力

quote: The results showed that acute heat shock at 34℃ signiﬁcantly induced the expression of ScHSP60 in these tissues.
statement: 结果显示，34℃的急性热休克显著诱导了这些组织中ScHSP60的表达。
text_zh: 结果显示，34℃的急性热休克显著诱导了这些组织中ScHSP60的表达。
text_en: The results showed that acute heat shock at 34°C significantly induced the expression of ScHSP60 in these tissues.

quote: In liver and head kidney, heat shock for 2 h resulted in the highest up-regulation by averages of 2.8- and 2.6-times that of   in controls.
statement: 在肝脏和头肾中，热休克2小时导致平均分别比对照组高2.8倍和2.6倍的最高上调。
text_zh: 在肝脏和头肾中，热休克2小时导致平均分别比对照组高2.8倍和2.6倍的最高上调。
text_en: In the liver and head kidney, heat shock for 2 hours resulted in maximum upregulation that was on average 2.8-fold and 2.6-fold higher than the control group, respectively.

quote: And when heat shock for 12 h, the ScHSP60 levels began to recover towards its baseline in heart and head kidney, and recovered and even below the baseline in liver.
statement: 当热休克持续12小时时，心脏和头肾中的ScHSP60水平开始向基线恢复，而在肝脏中则恢复甚至低于基线。
text_zh: 当热休克持续12小时时，心脏和头肾中的ScHSP60水平开始向基线恢复，而在肝脏中则恢复甚至低于基线。
text_en: When heat shock lasted for 12 hours, ScHSP60 levels in the heart and head kidney began to recover towards baseline, while in the liver they recovered to even below baseline.
